product.name: ALLO-501A
product.transgene: second-generation CAR; single-chain variable fragment (scFv) derived from a murine anti-human CD19 monoclonal antibody, with the human CD8 hinge and transmembrane domains, and a cytoplasmic tail composed of human 4-1BB co-stimulatory and human CD3ζ signaling domains
product.manufacturing_or_source: generated by transfection of two pairs of TALEN mRNA: one pair to inactivate TRAC and one pair to inactive CD52; pre-manufactured, TCRαβ depleted T cell suspension; CAR+_TCRαβ−_CD52+/− CAR T cells formulated at 20 × 106 viable CAR+ T cells/mL in a commercially available cryopreservation media

evidence.quote: IMP1: ALLO-501A, an allogeneic CAR T targeting CD19.
ALLO-501A is an allogeneic TRAC/CD52-knockout chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T cell therapy targeting CD19.
ALLO-501A is engineered using a self-inactivating lentiviral vector (LVV), which drives expression of a second-generation CAR, thus redirecting T cells to target CD19.

construct utilized in ALLO-501A combines a single-chain variable fragment (scFv) derived from a murine anti-human CD19 monoclonal antibody, with the human CD8 hinge and transmembrane domains, and a cytoplasmic tail composed of human 4-1BB co-stimulatory and human CD3ζ signaling domains.
ALLO-501A is generated by transfection of two pairs of TALEN mRNA: one pair to inactivate TRAC and one pair to inactive CD52 (Figure 4).
ALLO-501A is a pre-manufactured, TCRαβ depleted T cell suspension
The lentiviral vector used to generate ALLO-501A is derived from HIV-1
through the use of a third-generation vector, in which all sequences that encode lentiviral proteins have been deleted from the transfer vector.
The ALLO-501A dosage form is composed of CAR+_TCRαβ−_CD52+/− CAR T cells formulated at 20 × 106 viable CAR+ T cells/mL in a commercially available cryopreservation media.
All subjects will be treated with ALLO-501A 120 x 106 CAR+ cells following lymphodepletion.

notes: Sources: all 132 pages read; the 14 pages without a text layer (15, 87, 105, 107-110, 119, 121-124, 129, 131) were rendered and viewed. Entries taken from page images (marked read_from 'page image'): SoA table rows/section headers on pp. 121-123 and 129, the SoA abbreviation legend and SoA footnotes 1-6 on p. 124. Pages 15 (synopsis schema), 87 (stats/biomarker/immunogenicity analysis), 105 (ECOG), 107-110 (chronic GvHD grading), 119 (summary of follow-up), 131 (sponsor signature) contained nothing needed beyond that. Many timings and visit identifiers in the SoA and notes are redacted in the source ([redacted]); timing fields are null where only redacted values exist. Not found / not stated: no vector or transgene for ALLO-647 (amino-acid sequence comparator and formulation are redacted); no units stated for any immunogenicity, PK or cellular-kinetics assay; no specimen stated for screening DSA; no KIR typing, no vector integration-site method, no shedding or biodistribution assessments as such (ALLO-501A detection in lymph node/BM/CSF recorded as 'other'). Conflicts recorded with both sources: (1) ALLO-647 type: 'humanized monoclonal antibody' (pp. 12, 34) vs 'novel human monoclonal antibody (mAb)' (pp. 17, 19, 21). (2) ALLO-647 PK matrix: serum (SoA note 29, p. 127; p. 31) vs 'ALLO-647 plasma concentrations' (Section 9.3.4.2, p. 86); method 'immunoassay' (p. 127) vs 'ELISA-based monitoring' (p. 64). Fludarabine/cyclophosphamide PK: SoA row says serum concentration, note says blood samples, measured by immunoassay; Section 7.3 says ELISA-based. (3) SoA note 8 says 'ICE and ICANS grading scales are provided in Appendix 8', but Appendix 8 (p. 116) is the ICE score only; ICANS consensus grading is Appendix 9 (p. 117). Section 5.12.2 (p. 51) states the reverse (ICANS in Appendix 8, ICE in Appendix 9), while Section 7.1.1 cites Appendix 9 for neurotoxicity grading. (4) Urinalysis dipstick: Table 2 lists protein, glucose, creatinine and blood; SoA notes list protein, glucose and blood. (5) Pregnancy test: serum (Table 2; Section 7.1.6; inclusion 16) vs 'Serum or urine' (SoA note 16/7). (6) Hematology: Table 2 includes WBC, the SoA CBC note does not; chemistry lists differ slightly (Table 2 includes TSH, 'BUN or Urea'). (7) RCL sits in the SoA rows that follow the 'Local Laboratory' section header (p. 122), but Table 2 states 'RCL (Central laboratory)'. Cytokines: central lab, with CRS safety-management cytokines handled locally. (8) Abbreviation definitions differ between lists: MRD 'minimal residual disease' (App. 1, p. 33) vs 'minimum residual disease' (SoA legend); CBC 'complete blood cell count' (App. 1) vs 'complete blood count' (SoA legend/note); CT 'computed tomography' (SoA legend) vs 'computerized tomography' (SoA note 20); EQ-5D 'EuroQol standardized instrument' (App. 1) vs 'EQ 5D = EuroQol 5-Dimension questionnaire' (SoA legend); IRC 'Independent Radiology Committee' (App. 1, p. 14) vs 'independent review committee' (p. 33); ASBMT 'American Society for Bone and Marrow Transplantation' (App. 1) vs 'American Society for Blood and Marrow Transplantation' (p. 49) vs 'American Society for Bone and Marrow Transplant' (pp. 116-117); GVHD 'graft-vs-host disease' (App. 1) vs 'acute graft-vs-host disease' (p. 33); DSA 'donor specific antibody' (App. 1) vs 'Donor-specific anti-human leukocyte antigen (HLA) antibodies (DSA)' (SoA note). Text-layer artifacts kept as printed: line-break hyphens appear as 'anti- TPO', 'anti- neutrophil', 'cell- associated'; superscripts are lost (e.g. '120 x 106' = 120 x 10^6, 'mg/m2'). Abbreviations: Appendix 1 complete (pp. 102-104), SoA legend (p. 124, page image), Table 2 legend (p. 62), inline definitions in SoA notes, plus terms from the p. 33, p. 49 and p. 117 legends that are missing from Appendix 1 or defined differently there. SoA activity-name tokens not defined in Appendix 1: Temp, O₂ Sat (no definition anywhere), FCA-90 (a regimen name, explained in text on p. 9 but not listed as an abbreviation), CSF, CT, ECHO, TBNK, DNA, RNA (defined only in the SoA legend), CNA (defined only in SoA note 41). Defined in Appendix 1 under a different form: PBMCs (as PBMC), QLQ-C30 (as EORTC QLQ-C30).
